biotools.summary: MRspecLAB is an open-access, user-friendly software platform for MRS and MRSI data analysis designed to bridge the gap between technical experts and practitioners. It provides a graphical pipeline editor for both predefined and customizable workflows, facilitating data processing and analysis.
